data.name: Aas
data.gender_notes: Aas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aas means 'one who breathes'. It is derived from the verb ‘aa’sa which means ‘to breathe’. This name is often used to describe someone who is a strong supporter or protector. The name Aas carries the meaning “Respirer, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aas usually hope their child will grow to embody respirer, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to be a source of support and strength for others.
data.etymology: Aas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Respirer, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aas total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عاس
in_arabic.meaning: عاس تعني العاصي أو المتمرد على الأوامر الإلهية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عاس مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع ص ي' والذي يعني العصيان أو التمرد على الأوامر. في اللغة العربية، العاصي هو الشخص الذي يعصي ويتمرد على أوامر الله تعالى. ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَعْصِ مَنْ أَمَرَكَ' أي لا تعص من أمرك بالطاعة والانقياد لأوامره.

in_urdu.name: عاس
in_urdu.meaning: عاس کا مطلب ہے باغی یا احکام الہی کے خلاف جانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عاس نام عربی جڑ 'ع ص ي' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے باغی یا متمرد. اردو میں اس کا استعمال باغی یا دخل انداز شخص کے لئے ہوتا ہے. قرآنی سیاق و سباق میں یہ جڑ متعدد بار آیا ہے، جن میں اللہ تعالیٰ کا ارشاد ہے: 'وَلَا تَعْصِ مَنْ أَمَرَكَ' یعنی اس شخص کی مخالفت نہ کرنا جو تجھے حکم دیتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: आस
in_hindi.meaning: आस का अर्थ है विद्रोही या ईश्वरीय आदेशों के विरुद्ध जाने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: आस नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ع ص ي' से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है विद्रोही या आज्ञा का उल्लंघन करने वाला. हिंदी में इसका प्रयोग विद्रोही या आज्ञा भंग करने वाले व्यक्ति के लिए किया जाता है. इस जड़ का उल्लेख कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर मिलता है, जिनमें अल्लाह तआला का फरमान है: 'وَلَا تَعْصِ مَنْ أَمَرَكَ' अर्थात् उस व्यक्ति की अवज्ञा न करना जो तुम्हें आदेश देता है.

in_english.name: Aas
in_english.meaning: Aas means rebel or disobedient to divine commands
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aas is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ص ي' (ʿ-ṣ-y), which signifies rebellion or disobedience. In Islamic context, Aas refers to someone who defies or disobeys God's commands. This root is mentioned in several Quranic verses, including the command: 'Do not disobey him who commands you' (وَلَا تَعْصِ مَنْ أَمَرَكَ). Historically, the name has been used to signify a person who challenges authority or divine decree.

In various Islamic narratives, animals such as horses and camels are named Aas, signifying their crucial role in providing transportation and support to their owners. Furthermore, humans named Aas are also recognized for their important roles as protectors and helpers in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aas can be seen as a reminder of the importance of sustenance and the gift of breath from Allah. The notion of respiration and sustenance can be understood as a manifestation of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation. As mentioned in the Quran, "And Allah is He Who gives life and causes death, and He is sufficient in knowledge over everything." (Quran 30:45). Though seemingly insignificant, the act of breathing is crucial for maintaining life and is often taken for granted. The name Aas, therefore, can serve as a daily reminder of Allah's continuous care and support, encouraging us to appreciate and utilize our abilities and resources to their fullest potential while striving for His pleasure.
